brief:
Shehab Wire reported that a force identifying itself as "Deterrence" disclosed details of an armed confrontation targeting groups it characterized as collaborationist gangs operating in Jabalia, Gaza. The operation took place as part of what the force described as ongoing security operations in the territory.

According to the account, the ambush succeeded in preventing a kidnapping and inflicted direct casualties among the armed group members involved. The force released the details publicly, providing specifics of the encounter as it continued operations against organizations it said were working with external parties in the Gaza Strip.
